About this program
Find and solve problems through engineering.
Learn to develop and solve high level research problems in the field of civil and environmental engineering. In this program, you'll learn to address important contemporary challenges in transportation, structural, and environmental sectors through innovative and practical methods. Through your coursework, you'll establish the necessary tools to identify, propose, and implement solutions to real-life problems while developing the relationships and skills to expand your career in the direction of your choosing.
AT A GLANCE

This program has additional admissions requirements (beyond admission to NAU).
